{{Quote|Arm's probably broken. I'll be fine.|Bragger, to Lhagva|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
'''Bragger''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who fought for the [[Empire of the Hand]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Bragger participated in an Imperial [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], against the combined forces of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the battle, Bragger accompanied three stormtrooper [[Squad/Legends|squads]] that landed on Quethold and engaged a large number of Quesoth [[Quesoth Soldier|Soldiers]] inside the [[Red City]]. One of the Quesoth struck Bragger with a mace and the stormtrooper fell to the ground, and was subsequently saved by the stormtroopers [[Lhagva]] and [[Shrinks]], who fired upon Bragger's attacker. Bragger got back on his feet and suspected that his arm had been broken by the Quesoth's attack.
